agents.agent_name: IDOR Testing Agent for Coupon Redemption and Admin
IDOR Testing Agent for Coupon Redemption and Admin

instruction: Authorized security audit of the owner's OWN app (UniGoat: static HTML/JS/Capacitor + Supabase). Focus on: Supabase RLS/authorization gaps in supabase/migrations, exposed secrets/service_role keys in www/ client code, auth bypass, IDOR in coupon redemption (public.self_redeem) and www/admin.html, XSS in user-rendered content. Report only real, exploitable findings with file:line.

scan_results.executive_summary: Multiple agents encountered errors during the authorized security audit of the UniGoat app, resulting in failures for reconnaissance and vulnerability assessment. No valid findings were reported as the planned testing phases could not be executed successfully.
scan_results.methodology: Engagement focused on identifying Supabase RLS gaps, exposed secrets, and common web vulnerabilities (IDOR, XSS, auth bypass). Testing could not proceed due to agent failures.
scan_results.technical_analysis: The planned agents faced execution issues, preventing them from gathering necessary data on application security risks. Specific error details were not retrievable within the time constraints.
scan_results.recommendations: Investigate the underlying causes of the agent failures prior to re-running security assessments, ensuring all agents can operate effectively.
